remarks: This stunning home is located in an amenity rich community with quick and easy access to Highway 2 and the EIA international airport. This is a spacious single family 1713 sq ft home with a double front attached garage. Direct access to scenic walking paths, blending outdoor beauty with modern living. Bright, open-concept design ideal for entertaining family and friends. Side entrance with 9’ basement ceilings and 3-piece rough-in, offering potential for a future development. Spacious walkthrough mudroom with built-in bench, hooks, shelves, and organizers. Large walkthrough pantry. Ceiling-height kitchen cabinetry with upgraded quartz countertops. Luxury Vinyl Plank flooring throughout the main floor and all wet areas. 50” electric F/P in the great room for added warmth and style. Upgraded spindle railing. Central bonus room perfect for relaxation or entertainment. Second-floor laundry room with space for side-by-side washer and dryer. Ensuite has dual sinks for added comfort. Photos are representative. (id:67522)
